tests.case: hidden scope reload cancels and rejects an obsolete cancellation-ignoring result
Hidden_scope_rebuilds_real_ownerships_while_an_ignored_cancelled_read_cannot_complete_its_HTTP_client
Matching_replacement_reads_share_current_facts_while_nonmatching_and_obsolete_reads_remain_distinct
source hidden scope cancels the obsolete two-owner read and preserves the current one-hour result
History_reads_ending_at_as_of_do_not_consume_dashboard_gates

GameplayStatsViewModelTests.Hidden_scope.reason: Both surfaces retain the original Game 1/Game 2 ownerships. Hiding work 2 cancels the held two-owner read and publishes 3,600 seconds from ownership 1; releasing the old 999,999-second result cannot replace the displayed one hour. Real SQLite visibility changes and HTTP request ledgers preserve the source scope assertions. Electron snapshot invalidation can issue canceled intermediate reads, so every matching replacement request receives the same current facts while the original read remains held until explicit release. A deferred read transaction preserves the coherent library/statistics snapshot without blocking the hide or replacement read. Native gates distinguish dashboard reads by the fixed as-of clock and an inclusive-date end different from as-of; incidental History reads end at as-of and remain separately recorded. Initial loading assertions prove the held read belongs to Gameplay.

GameplayStatsInteractionTests.Fullscreen.reason: The real fullscreen shell runs at 1920×1080 with text scales 1 and 1.4. Gameplay is the selected section, with the authored 3 px underline, 28×scale section text and 24×scale Recorded hours caption.
